signing.note: Signed by authorised signatory with company seal. Confirm digital/scanned acceptance with your branch.

channels.title: Kotak Net Banking / Kotak Fyn
steps: Log in to Kotak Net Banking or Kotak Fyn portal.
Submit export documents or inquire with your Relationship Manager.
Confirm the digital EDF submission process with your branch as Kotak does not publish public menu steps.

channels.title: Email to Branch or Relationship Manager
steps: Open the email draft to your Kotak branch or Relationship Manager.
Attach the downloaded EDF PDF, the invoice XLSX spreadsheet, and invoice copies.
Send before {dueDate} and request an acknowledgement email or reference number.
Save the bank's written acknowledgement and upload it back to Korra.

channels.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Branch / Trade Desk
steps: Print the downloaded EDF (RBI Annex) and sign it with company seal.
Prepare supporting invoice copies and contracts.
Submit at the Trade Desk or Forex Branch of Kotak Mahindra Bank before {dueDate}.
Collect the stamped acknowledgement copy and upload it to Korra.

email.subject: EDF Submission - {month} - Kotak Mahindra Bank (AD Code: {adCode})
email.intro: Please find attached our Export Declaration Form (EDF) and supporting export invoice documents for {month} under FEMA 23(R).
